description_en: Queries statistics on data endpoints associated with API security sensitive data domains
description_zh: 查询API安全敏感数据域名统计
name: DescribeApisecSensitiveDomainStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 5, which indicates 5 entries per page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为5，表示每页包含5条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of sensitive data. Valid values:

request: request sensitive data.

response: response sensitive data
parameters.help_zh:
敏感数据类型。取值：

request：请求敏感数据。

response：响应敏感数据
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.

desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
列表排序方式。取值：

asc：正序。

desc：倒序
parameters.name: order_way

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

DomainCount.description_en: The number of involved domain names

SensitiveCode.description_en:
The code of the sensitive data type.
You can call [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） to obtain the supported sensitive data types
SensitiveCode.description_zh:
敏感数据Code。
您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持的敏感数据类型

SensitiveLevel.description_en:
The sensitivity level of the API. Valid values:
S1: low sensitivity.
S2: medium sensitivity.
S3: high sensitivity
SensitiveLevel.description_zh:
接口敏感等级。取值：
S1：表示低敏感。
S2：表示中敏感。
S3：表示高敏感

SensitiveName.description_en: The name of the sensitive data type

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
